newsitem.title: USA: TALX, Pinnacle Group form partnership.
newsitem.headline: TALX, Pinnacle Group form partnership.

text.p: TALX Corp said Monday it will form a partnership with Pinnacle Group Inc involving cross-marketing of each company's products and services.

Pinnacle, a privately held information services and consulting firm, will offer TALX's line of interactive communications products, a TALX spokesman said. TALX will also offer Pinnacle's services to its customers as part of the business agreement. No commissions will be paid by either company, the TALX spokesman said.
TALX makes communications products. Its stock closed up 1/8 Monday at 8-1/8.
